_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 30d momentum 0% and only 3% of 12h windows move score ±2 = coil; price flush does not break the Anxiety band without fuel.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst explicit phase HOLD + tactical short; narrative has no phase call but is price-bearish — aligned on no immediate upside rung shift
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays below ~80,000 and cycle score holds inside Anxiety (39-46) over next 12h windows
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC reclaims ~80,000 with ETF flows and CVD turning up, or score leaves 39-46 into Denial or Complacency
